profile.name: SpectrAcq3 单通道探测器采集接口
profile.description: 用于单通道光谱探测器的数据采集设备，可进行连接管理、设置高压偏置、电气触发与采集参数配置，并控制采集启动、暂停、继续和停止，适用于光谱信号采集与触发测量实验。
profile.description_en: A data acquisition device for single-channel spectroscopy detectors. It supports connection control, high-voltage bias configuration, electrical trigger setup, acquisition parameter definition, and start/pause/continue/stop of acquisitions for spectroscopy signal collection and triggered measurements.
